# remote_search_tool

> Search code on a remote workspace via SSH using ripgrep (rg) or grep.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `developer` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=remote_search_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Search code on a remote workspace via SSH using ripgrep (rg) or grep.

Searches file contents for a pattern. Prefers ripgrep if available on the remote
server, falls back to grep. Returns matching lines with file paths and line numbers.

EXAMPLES:

Search for a class definition:
{workspace_slug: "my-project", pattern: "class UserController"}

Case-insensitive search in Ruby files:
{workspace_slug: "my-project", pattern: "def create", file_glob: "*.rb", case_sensitive: false}

Search with limited results:
{workspace_slug: "my-project", pattern: "TODO", max_results: 20}

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workspace_slug` | string | yes | Workspace slug identifying which remote server to connect to. |
| `pattern` | string | yes | Search pattern (regex supported) |
| `file_glob` | string | no | File glob pattern to filter (e.g., "*.rb", "*.ts") |
| `case_sensitive` | boolean | no | Case-sensitive search (default: true) |
| `max_results` | integer | no | Maximum number of results (default: 50) |
